split: maximum main one frame per child; maximum reset one ID per child; other reset at most8 owners+8 complete fresh per child; other main one finite job per profile
strict_result_policy: all children hard20s; timeout terminal no retry/reduce/split; ordinary FAIL preserve exact tested sources/receipt/NOT_RUN and stop; legal compile stderr empty; version record only; named reject must mention qoi_encoder_invalid_configuration

verification_timing.exact_tail: Count rising edges strictly after final input acceptance through summary acceptance inclusive: closed tail + output_holds*(public_bytes+1). Capture gaps do not enter this tail.
verification_timing.main_queue: After final pixel acceptance, offer the next main frame pixel0 at the following negative edge and hold the complete first beat until accepted. No next-frame input may retire through file output or held summary. Earliest new acceptance is the edge after summary acceptance.
verification_timing.output_hold: For each newly presented byte and summary, hold ready low for exactly the block output_holds full active edges, then accept once; output data and all metadata must remain stable.
verification_timing.owner_work: Capture writes equal capture_limit. raw/history action counts and retired prefix are the values before the reset target edge; held SEND/DONE adds no work.
verification_timing.reset_capture: CAPTURE reset owners stop after capture_limit accepted inputs; wait until the next negative edge, assert reset before another input acceptance. Stored owner inputs remain a complete N-row specification.
verification_timing.reset_release: Keep reset high across two rising edges. Check level-gated ready/valid/markers before an edge and cancellation at the first reset edge. Deassert at a negative edge, then offer the full fresh frame from its pixel0; no owner output may reappear.
verification_timing.reset_target: With owner output always ready until the chosen target, paper_trace_index0 is CHECK on the first edge after final capture. Assert reset at the negative edge immediately before the target edge; confirm frozen target state, semantic qualifier, retired prefix and issued RAM actions. For SEND/DONE, first hold ready low three edges at that target, check stability, then assert reset without retirement.
verification_timing.source_gap: Insert one idle input edge before accepted pixel i when i>0 and i%period==0; period0 inserts no gaps. Pixel0 is offered without a gap.
